label: the basin crew
note: Issue #615: the second rung of the race ladder: three locals who race out of the droid post in the basin, south of the port, on the Basin Run. They only race you once you have beaten the yard crew (`after`). Same shape as yard.json (read its note); `rung` orders the ladder, `after` is the crew you must beat first, and `rules.gear` the race gear they may use (issue #616). Speeder classes: the second racer drives a box truck with a racing engine (`model`), the fastest thing here on a straight; the others ride tuned Sand-boxers; they bring seekers and mines.
